articles.summary: CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) announced today that it will host a webcast conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 7:30 a.m. CT/8:30 a.m. ET. A live webcast (audio with slides) of the conference call will be accessible at investor.CDW.com . The press release and presentation slides will be posted on this website prior to the call. Please visit the website at least fifteen minutes prior to the call to register and to download and install any necessary software. A taped replay of the webcast will be available on the website shortly after the call. For questions, please email investorrelations@cdw.com . About CDW CDW Corporation is a leading multi-brand provider of information technology solutions to business, government, education and healthcare customers in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. articles.summary: Former Global CEO, Deloitte Consulting Advisory brings extensive experience in technology and services, transformation and global business leadership CDW (Nasdaq: CDW), the strategic end-to-end technology partner that turns customer ambition into outcomes, today announced the appointment of Sam Balaji to its Board of Directors, effective October 15, 2026. Balaji brings more than three decades of experience in technology, advisory and global business leadership. Most recently, he served as Global Chief Executive Officer of Consulting Advisory at Deloitte, where he helped build and scale multibillion-dollar businesses and markets, spanning artificial intelligence, cloud, cybersecurity and digital transformation.
